index.title: SpringWave | AI-Powered Student Growth Platform
index.hero_desc: SpringWave uses AI to help students find activities, communities, competitions, and opportunities that align with their goals, interests, and personal growth journey.
index.how_heading: Three Steps to Your Growth Journey
index.how_desc: SpringWave's AI engine analyzes your profile and creates a personalized path toward your goals.
index.step1_desc: Answer a few questions about your interests, skills, and goals. Our AI builds your unique profile.
index.step2_desc: Receive tailored opportunities ranked by match score — from workshops to career programs.
index.step3_desc: Track progress, develop skills, and follow your AI-generated roadmap toward your dream career.
index.ai_desc: Our AI analyzes your major, interests, skill gaps, and career goals to find the perfect opportunities for you.
index.ai_evaluates: Our AI evaluates 15+ dimensions to find your ideal opportunities
index.community_desc: Join discussions with students from Da Nang's top universities. Share insights, ask questions, and grow together.
index.testimonial_desc: Hear from students who transformed their university experience with SpringWave.
index.cta_desc: Discover opportunities, build skills, and grow with AI-powered guidance. Join thousands of students already on SpringWave.
index.showcase_desc: Track your extracurricular progress, levels, and badge milestones in real-time. Our AI Companion keeps you motivated and recommends opportunities based on your skills.
index.showcase_badges_desc: Unlock newbie, explorer, and legendary badges as you engage in student life.
index.showcase_levels_desc: Gain contribution score points for writing replies, starting threads, and participating in workshops.
index.testimonial_lc: "SpringWave recommended a UX workshop that completely changed my career direction. I found my passion for product design, collaborated with tech mentors, and secured an internship within months!"
index.testimonial_ma: "Anyone joining the AI Hackathon next month? Looking for team members interested in NLP."
index.testimonial_tt: "Best volunteering programs this month? Looking for something meaningful to do on weekends."
index.testimonial_kn: "SpringWave helped me realize my goal of becoming a Product Manager was achievable. The AI roadmap was incredibly accurate."
index.bento_stars_desc: Average workshop rating from 1,200+ feedback surveys.
index.bento_smart_connect_desc: Cross-uni study buddies matched dynamically by skill set.

about.title: About Us — SpringWave
about.hero_desc: Built by students, for students — a platform that helps you discover opportunities, connect with communities, and grow beyond the classroom.
about.why_desc: Students often miss out on opportunities because information about workshops, competitions, extracurricular activities, and academic programs is scattered across dozens of fanpages, Facebook groups, and websites. We built SpringWave to change that.
about.why_goal: A central platform where students can discover academic and extracurricular activities that match their interests, abilities, and personal growth direction.
about.believe_1: Every student has unique potential waiting to be discovered.
about.believe_2: Opportunities should never be limited by lack of information.
about.believe_3: AI can be a companion that helps students make better choices.
about.believe_4: Technology should serve people and community first.
about.team_desc: SpringWave is developed by RAH — Really Awesome Human.
about.team_subtitle: We are first-year students with a passion for technology, AI, and building real-world products.
about.journey: SpringWave is not just a school project — it is the beginning of a journey to create technology solutions that bring real value to the Vietnamese student community.
about.cta_desc: Join SpringWave today and discover opportunities that match who you are.

student_verify.auto_verify_desc: Your email {{email}} is a school email. Once you enter your Student ID and upload your student card photo, your account will be verified instantly without waiting for admin approval.

student_verify.alert_success_std: Verification request submitted! Admins will review and respond soon.
student_verify.status_approved_desc: Your account has been student verified (Student ID: {{id}}).
